title: Safety, Tolerability and Preliminary Efficacy of Lenodiar Pediatric in Diarrhea
brief_summary: Evaluation of the efficacy of a treatment with Actitan-F, a natural molecular complex of tannins (from Agrimony and Tormentil) and flavonoids (Chamomile) in a pediatric population of children affected by acture/prolonged/chronic diarrhea
